title: Qualify 40 GiB external shuffle comparators
question: How do the selected large-file external shuffle workflows fare at 40 GiB inside the same hard memory cap?
summary: One 40 GiB qualification completed in 551.724 s for opt-in Chopper and 806.991 s for qsvlite. The original DuckDB adapter denied memory during sort materialization at 256 and 512 MiB engine settings.

workloads: 40 GiB exact Uniform then Balanced equivalent shape, plain fixed-width CSV, eight exact groups, 1 GiB hard cgroup with no swap.

validation.summary: Independent full all-field, unique ID, quota, cap and nonidentity oracle for both completed jobs. Chopper manifest and cleanup also checked. Both failed DuckDB settings passed the small preflight.

limitations: WSL2/ext4 with uncontrolled backing cache. Each full completion is one sample.
qsvlite uses a fixture-specific external line sort with one requested worker per command. UUID generation and reorder can overlap.
DuckDB failures cover one chosen materialized adapter. Full output timings exclude both failures.
exclusions: Fixture hashing and output verification are outside timing. Small qualifications and unsuccessful attempts excluded from complete elapsed comparisons.
reopen_when: Qualify a streaming DuckDB writer adapter or a different exact external algorithm under the same hard cap before generalizing.
